title: Meta bought about $1.05B of Arista network gear in 2024

sources.quote: And sales to our end customer Meta Platforms represented 15%, 21% and 26% of our total revenue, respectively for the years ended 2024, 2023 and 2022.

explain: Meta buys Arista's data center switches to connect the servers and GPU clusters that run its AI. Arista's annual report says Meta was 15% of its 2024 revenue of $7.0 billion, so roughly $1.05 billion; that dollar figure is our calculation, not a number Arista reported.
